Nepal Election Results 2026 Live: Balen Shah’s RSP leads on 98 seats, rivals trail far behind
China asserts need for more power as Donald Trump embraces war
item.description: Chinese analysts believe the US would not target Xi Jinping like it did Khamenei due to China's nuclear status. However, Trump's embrace of war reinforces Beijing's view of the US as its primary threat, prompting calls for superior firepower and self-reliance. China also warns against internal threats and deceptive negotiations with Washington.

item.title: UAE: Dubai confirms driver killed after debris from intercepted missile strikes car in Al Barsha amid Iran vs US-Israel war
item.description: A Pakistani driver tragically died in Dubai when debris from an aerial interception fell on his vehicle. This incident, linked to escalating regional conflict, highlights the unpredictable dangers of modern warfare even with successful air defence. The UAE's advanced systems intercepted threats but falling fragments posed a risk to civilians in densely populated areas.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Explosion scare in Dubai Marina: UAE emirate confirms tower hit by falling debris from aerial interception amid Iran and US-Israel clashes
item.description: Dubai authorities confirmed that debris from a successful aerial interception, not a direct attack, caused a minor incident in Dubai Marina. The event was linked to regional tensions and ongoing conflict involving Iran, the United States and Israel and resulted in falling debris that struck a tower, with no injuries reported.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Stress, panic or burnout? Free mental health helplines that are open 24/7 in the UAE
item.description: Mental health awareness is growing across the UAE. Free and confidential helplines are now available 24 hours a day. These services offer immediate support for anxiety, stress and other emotional challenges. Organizations like SAKINA and the National Mental Support Line provide crucial assistance. This initiative ensures accessible help for everyone, promoting wellbeing nationwide.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Emaar founder boldly reveals why Dubai’s property market has ‘nothing to fear’ amid Iran and US-Israel war
item.description: Despite regional geopolitical tensions and an anticipated surge in new housing supply, Dubai's real estate sector remains resilient, according to Emaar Properties founder Mohamed Alabbar. He asserts that the market has strong fundamentals and long-term planning to weather shocks, with record sales and luxury segment growth fueling optimism for continued stability and expansion.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘I like Kamla better’: Trump jokes about similarity between Trinidad PM’s name and Kamala Harris — watch
item.description: During the 2026 Summit of the Americas, President Trump lightheartedly noted the similarity between Prime Minister Kamla Persad-Bissessar's first name and former Vice President Kamala Harris. Trump joked about the pronunciation difference, stating he preferred 'Kamla' and humorously warned against mixing them up. The exchange occurred as leaders gathered to discuss regional security and migration.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE Lottery: Over 8,000 residents bag prizes while Dh30 million jackpot still waiting
item.description: The UAE Lottery's "Lucky Day" draw saw over 8,299 winners, with four individuals securing Dh100,000 each. Despite the substantial number of winners, the Dh30 million jackpot remained unclaimed, continuing the excitement for a life-changing win. The lottery has already distributed over Dh147 million to more than 100,000 players since its launch.

item.title: Zohran Mamdani reassured Jewish New Yorkers but his wife’s Oct 7 social media activity tells another story
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani faces questions regarding his administration's stance against antisemitism. This follows resurfaced social media activity by his wife, Rama Duwaji, liking posts after the October 7 Hamas attack. Mamdani's past support for pro-Palestinian movements and criticism of Israel also draw attention. The controversy highlights concerns within the city's large Jewish community.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'What is with this obsession with Indians?': Indian Entrepreneur hits out at criticism of folk dancer
item.description: An Indian entrepreneur in Germany labeled backlash against a folk dancer at the Washington Monument as "straight up racism," highlighting perceived double standards. He questioned the intense negativity towards Indian immigrants and their cultural expressions, suggesting appreciation and gratitude would be more fitting responses.

item.title: Inside world’s longest non-stop flight set to launch next year, where passengers see two sunrises
item.description: Qantas is set to launch its Project Sunrise flights, linking Sydney non-stop to London and New York, over 10,000 miles in around 22 hours. Using specially configured Airbus A350-1000ULR aircraft, the airline aims to cut travel time, reduce jet lag, and offer wellness-focused cabins. The ambitious ultra-long-haul service could transform global aviation and redefine long-distance travel experiences.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: UAE residents turn to secret land routes to escape travel shutdown amid Iran and US–Israel war
item.description: Escalating Iran-US-Israel conflict has caused unprecedented travel disruptions across the Middle East. Thousands of travelers and expatriates in the Gulf are now using land corridors and emergency services to leave the region as airspace closures and flight cancellations persist. This crisis is reshaping regional mobility and impacting global aviation networks.

item.title: Watch: Video shows passengers raising hands as man is dragged off Southwest flight after security scare
item.description: A Southwest Airlines flight en route to Fort Lauderdale made an emergency landing in Atlanta Friday night due to a security threat. Passengers were filmed with hands raised as police boarded the aircraft and removed a man. The incident caused a dramatic disruption to the flight's original route.

Jeffrey Epstein guard googled him 40 minutes before his death and made $5K cash deposit days earlier: DoJ files show
item.description: New Justice Department documents reveal Tova Noel, Epstein's guard, Googled him minutes before his death and made a large cash deposit prior. She allegedly falsified records, admitting to not always performing required checks. The FBI identified her as a possible orange figure near his cell on surveillance footage, a detail previously unconfirmed.
